description: This file implements core diffing functionality with a focus on pickaxe-based searching within diff outputs. It includes functions to match diff content using regular expressions or exact string matching, processes diff file pairs, and applies filtering based on user options. The code is part of a version control system, likely Git, with functions supporting textual diff analysis, regex compilation, and diff queue processing.

methods.name: void diffcore_pickaxe(struct diff_options * o)
methods.description: Main entry point for applying pickaxe-based filtering on diff content within a diff_options structure.

void regcomp_or_die(regex_t * regex,const char * needle,int cflags)
